t.Sua nota do Google caiu de repente? Veja: Did your Google rating drop suddenly? See the 6 most common causes (from removed reviews to a competitor attack), how to identify each one and the 48-hour response checklist.
t.Nota do Google caiu de repente? As 6 cau: Google rating dropped suddenly? The 6 causes and what to do in 48h
t.Você abre o perfil e a nota que era 4,7: You open your profile and the rating that was 4.7 woke up as 4.3. No new customer complained to your face, but the number dropped overnight. Before you panic or start asking everyone for reviews, take a breath: almost every sudden drop has an identifiable cause. This guide shows the 6 most common ones, how to find out which is yours and what to do in the first 48 hours.
t.As 6 causas de uma queda súbita na nota: The 6 causes of a sudden rating drop
t.1. O Google removeu avaliações (e as boa: 1. Google removed reviews (and most of them were good ones)
t.Essa é a causa mais comum e a mais mal i: This is the most common cause and the most misunderstood. Every so often Google runs an anti-fraud sweep and deletes reviews it considers suspicious — accounts with no history, odd posting patterns, reviews that look incentivized or bought. If a good share of your 5 stars were of that kind, they disappear and the average collapses.
t.Aqui vem a parte incômoda: se avaliações: Here comes the uncomfortable part: if removed reviews brought your rating down, it means part of your reputation was resting on reviews Google didn't consider legitimate. Getting angry at Google won't help — the way out is to rebuild with real reviews, which we cover at the end.
t.2. Ataque de concorrente ou avaliações f: 2. Competitor attack or fake negative reviews
t.O outro lado da moeda: alguém despejou u: The other side of the coin: someone dumped a pile of 1-star reviews on your profile in a short time. It could be a competitor, a disgruntled former employee or a coordinated attack (sometimes even by mistake, with people reviewing the wrong business).
t.3. Uma onda de críticas reais (algo mudo: 3. A wave of real complaints (something changed in your operation)
t.Às vezes a nota não \"caiu\": ela virou: Sometimes the rating didn't "drop": it became a different one. This happens when Google merges two duplicate profiles of the same business, when you change the address or category, or when you claim a profile that already existed with old reviews. The result is a different average that looks like a drop.
t.5. Avaliações compradas detectadas e der: 5. Bought reviews detected and taken down
t.Se em algum momento você (ou uma agência: If at some point you (or an agency that promised to "fill your profile with 5 stars") bought reviews, this is the day the bill comes due. Google improves its detectors all the time, and when it identifies a batch of fake reviews, it removes them all at once — sometimes with a warning on the profile, sometimes silently.
t.6. Bug de exibição (a nota não caiu de v: 6. Display bug (the rating didn't really drop)
t.Nem toda queda é real. Às vezes é atraso: Not every drop is real. Sometimes it's a sync delay between Google Maps, Search and the Google Business Profile dashboard, browser cache, or a review still being processed that hasn't been counted yet. The rating "disappears" or fluctuates for a few hours and goes back to normal on its own.
t.O checklist de reação nas primeiras 48 h: The response checklist for the first 48 hours
t.Identificada a causa provável, aja em or: Once you've identified the likely cause, act in order. Don't skip steps — half of all mistakes come from reacting before understanding.
t.Como saber, de fato, se a queda foi ataq: How to really know whether the drop was an attack, a cleanup or your operation
t.O problema é que a maioria dos donos não: The problem is that most owners don't have the "before". Nobody writes down their rating every week — so when it drops, there's no point of comparison to know the size and origin of the damage. That's exactly the blind spot a diagnosis solves: seeing where you stand today against competitors in your category and area, so you react based on data, not on fright.
t.O antídoto de longo prazo: volume real e: The long-term antidote: real, steady volume
t.É por isso que placas de NFC e QR Code n: That's why NFC and QR Code stands on the counter have become standard in local businesses that grow their reputation: the customer already has the phone in hand, taps or scans and reviews in 30 seconds, without "I'll do it later". A steady flow of genuine reviews doesn't just recover from a drop — it protects you from the next one.

h.Uma nota do Google não cai sozinha. Ela: A Google rating doesn't drop on its own. It's an average — so for it to change suddenly, either new low reviews came in, or old high reviews went out. It sounds obvious, but that's exactly where the diagnosis starts: the right question isn't "why did my rating drop?", but "did the number of reviews go up, down or stay the same when the rating changed?".
h.Se você tem 40 avaliações e a média cai: If you have 40 reviews and the average drops half a point in a day, a single new star doesn't explain it — because the weight of one review out of 40 is small. A big, sudden drop almost always means several reviews changed status at the same time. Keep this logic in mind; it will help you spot the cause at a glance.
h.Primeiro passo, antes de tudo: anote ago: First step, before anything else: write down right now the current rating, the total number of reviews and the date. Without this "before and after", any diagnosis is a guess. If you track this week by week, you're already ahead.
h.Como identificar: o número total de aval: How to identify it: the total number of reviews dropped along with the rating. You had 120, now you have 98, and the average went down. That's the classic picture of a Google cleanup.
h.Como identificar: o número de avaliações: How to identify it: the number of reviews went up, but with a flood of low ratings in a short span — often with no text, from accounts with no photo and no history, sometimes from another city. If you recognize that none of these "customers" ever set foot in your business, it's an attack.
h.Menos dramático, mais difícil de ouvir:: Less dramatic, harder to hear: the negative reviews are genuine. You changed staff, switched suppliers, got overwhelmed in a peak month, raised prices without notice — and customers reacted. A bakery that changed bakers, a repair shop that took longer to deliver, a restaurant that got packed and lost its touch with service.
h.Como identificar: as críticas novas cita: How to identify it: the new complaints mention concrete, recurring problems (the same kind of complaint repeats), come from accounts that look like real customers and match some change you know happened. It hurts, but it's the most valuable cause of all — because it's the only one that points to a real fix in the business.
h.Como identificar: a mudança coincide com: How to identify it: the change coincides with some listing edit you (or Google) made — new address, adjusted name, changed categories, a "profiles merged" notice. The total number of reviews usually makes an odd jump, up or down.
h.Como identificar: some um bloco grande d: How to identify it: a large block of 5-star reviews disappears — ones that had come in more or less together, from generic accounts, not too long ago. If you recognize that origin, that's the diagnosis.
h.Vale o alerta direto: comprar avaliação: A blunt warning: buying reviews is never worth it. The gain is temporary and the risk is losing the bought reviews, watching your rating plunge all at once and, in the worst case, getting your profile suspended. If this was your cause, treat it as a fresh start on honest ground — it's the only kind that lasts.
h.Como identificar: a nota diverge entre o: How to identify it: the rating differs depending on where you look (Maps shows one, Search shows another), the total number of reviews didn't change in a consistent way, and when you check from another device/incognito tab the number is different. In these cases, wait 24 to 48 hours before reacting — lots of people rush to fix a problem that doesn't exist.
h.Confirme que a queda é real. Abra o perf: Confirm the drop is real. Open the profile in an incognito tab and on another device. Compare Maps and Search. If they differ, it's probably cause 6 (bug) — wait 48h.
h.Leia as avaliações novas, uma a uma. Ela: Read the new reviews, one by one. They tell you what came in. Low ratings with real text and a specific complaint point to cause 3; a flood of empty 1-star reviews from ghost accounts points to cause 2.
h.Cheque se o total de avaliações caiu. Se: Check whether the total number of reviews dropped. If it dropped, reviews were removed (cause 1 or 5). If it went up, reviews were added (cause 2 or 3).
h.Denuncie o que viola as políticas. Avali: Report what violates the policies. Fake reviews, from people who were never customers, offensive ones or from competitors: open the review, tap the three dots, "Report review". It's not a button for deleting genuine criticism — only what breaks the rules comes down.
h.Responda as críticas reais com cabeça fr: Reply to genuine complaints with a cool head. A mature public reply, within 24 to 48h, is worth more to readers than the rating itself. Never argue point by point or expose the customer's data.
h.Não tente \"compensar\" comprando avalia: Don't try to "make up for it" by buying reviews. It's the most common reflex and the most dangerous. You trade a drop for a risk of suspension. Instead, start collecting real reviews steadily.
h.O que NÃO fazer nas primeiras horas: apa: What NOT to do in the first hours: delete the profile and create another one (you lose your whole history), reply on impulse, ask for reviews en masse only from people very close to you (Google notices artificial spikes) and, above all, buy reviews to "plug the hole".
h.A diferença entre as causas está quase s: The difference between the causes almost always lies in crossing two numbers: the rating and the number of reviews, before and after. If the total went down, reviews went out — a Google cleanup or detected purchase. If the total went up, reviews came in — a fake attack or a real wave. And the content of the new reviews (real vs. ghost accounts, specific complaint vs. silent 1 star) separates an attack from legitimate criticism.
h.Repare que quatro das seis causas (limpe: Notice that four of the six causes (cleanup, attack, real wave, detected purchase) hurt much more when the profile has few reviews. With 30 reviews, five low ratings knock the average right down. With 400, the same five become a footnote and the rating barely moves. Real volume is the shock absorber that protects your reputation from any bump.
h.E \"volume real\" tem sobrenome: constan: And "real volume" has a last name: steady and honest. No buying 5-star packages — that's cause 5 waiting to happen — and no review gating, the practice of filtering who reviews so only happy customers get sent to Google. Besides being against the policies and putting the profile at risk, it blinds you to the real problems that cause 3 reveals. The path that lasts is the boring one: ask every satisfied customer for a review, always, with as little friction as possible.
